title: Removable matchings in $2$-connected graphs
summary: A matching $M$ of a $2$-connected graph $G$ is removable if $G-M$ is $2$-connected, extending Halin's classical notion of a removable edge. We prove that for every integer $d\ge 5$, every $2$-connected graph $G$ with $δ(G)\ge d$ and $|V(G)|\ge 2d$ has a removable $d$-matching. This is best possible, since the complete bipartite graph $K_{d,\,n-d}$ on $n\,(\ge 2d)$ vertices has no $(d+1)$-matching.
